mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates cheaper borrowing for corporate expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 198.0 signals persistent inflation, triggering Federal Reserve rate hikes that compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 198.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumption (RSAFS) indicates robust economic expansion, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through synchronized demand acceleration.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST > 2000 and RSAFS > 350000.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market cooling regime (UNRATE > 5.0), the Federal Reserve is likely to cut interest rates to stimulate the economy, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through increased output capacity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 108.0.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level above 11200 billion dollars indicates strong economic growth, supporting corporate profits and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained demand expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 > 11200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to immediate policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total payroll employment (PAYEMS) reflects a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 134000.0.
